## Disposition and attribution

Record **30002367 / OWR-12495-007** as a credited prior resolution of Totaro's finite-group mod-p Chow detection/suspension conjecture by **David Hemminger**, Proposition 6.1 with Theorem 5.6 and the coarse Theorem 6.2(a), [Algebraic & Geometric Topology 21(4) (2021), 1881–1910](https://doi.org/10.2140/agt.2021.21.1881). **Zero new target proof-attempt turns; no novelty claim for the target theorem.**

This edition's authored certificate, audit, centralizer correction, independent review, and acceptance report are **AI-assisted and unrefereed**, without proof-assistant certification. Their scoped acceptance is relative to explicitly named external foundations. This status is distinct from the prior article's journal publication.

## Exact accepted scope and retained mathematics

For every finite constant group G, every prime p, and every field k with char(k) different from p containing all pth roots of unity, the centralizer-detection degree of CH^*(BG_k)/p equals its greatest nonzero unstable-module suspension degree. The grading is Chow codimension: suspension d corresponds to topological shift 2d. No algebraic closedness, perfectness, p-coprimality of |G|, Noetherianity, or finite-dimensionality of general graded Chow groups is assumed.

The complete mathematical text retains the localization/detection bridge, actual multiplication pullbacks, augmentation inverse, correct centralizer inclusion, coarse finite bound, terminal-filtration argument, and direct odd-reduced-layer parity proof. The complete local correction retains character-block GL centralizers, rational split transporters, the actual C_G(λ) action, explicit blockwise flag presentations and faithful free bases, and all mixed-component descent equations.

The inspected [arXiv:1911.03033v2](https://arxiv.org/abs/1911.03033v2) requires the recorded qualifications on page 5 (general odd-prime lower-operation formula), page 8 (literal even-square subalgebra claim), page 16 (rank-only centralizer formula and bottom-row descent), and page 21 (centralizer-map direction and finite-sum tensor interpretation). The corrected account retains categorical degree doubling and the named nilpotent-filtration, Lannes/Brown–Gitler, and equivariant Chow/Steenrod foundations. The journal PDF was access-denied and is uninspected; **no journal-error or manuscript/journal byte-identity claim is made**.

## Edition contents and boundary

Adds exactly eleven files under unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/30002367/: README.md, APPLICABILITY_CERTIFICATE.md, MATHEMATICAL_AUDIT.md, CENTRALIZER_DESCENT_CORRECTION.md, INDEPENDENT_REVIEW.md, ACCEPTANCE.md, ACCEPTANCE.json, SOURCE_LEDGER.json, STATUS.json, PROVENANCE.md, and MANIFEST.json.

All accepted mathematical text is retained. Editorial changes add authorship-status clarity and remove corpus/procedural material and non-PDF artifact identities. The packet includes public scholarly citations, PDF hashes and sizes, retrieval and inspection history, and precise acceptance boundaries. It excludes source-document bodies, extracts and images; dataset contents; scripts, checkers, computational logs and result artifacts; and private coordination material. No omitted computation is replaced by prose. No QUEUE.md change is included.
